name: HTC Vive / Vive Pro wands
label: Vive / Vive Pro wands
about: Trackpads instead of sticks, and four buttons; played as the Valve Index is as far as they go (Layout = index): right trigger = interact, the grips (buttons) for your hands, the sword strikes by swinging (power attack: fist by your right ear). The left trackpad walks (touch it; press it: sprint), the right one turns (press it: jump); right menu button = crouch, left menu button = the menu (short: journal, held: pause). There are not enough buttons for the quick slots (use the power wheel on the left grip, the holsters, and MouthPotions for elixirs) or zoom. Any setting of DishonoredVR.ini can be put in 'settings'; the ones here win over the ini's. The VR options tabs save these values back into this file.

notes.Layout: index = the Valve Index's layout (the one the mod is tuned for): right trigger = interact, the grips are for your hands (grab, pull, holsters; the right one blocks only with the sword out; an object stays in your hand while you hold the grip), the sword strikes by swinging. Without trackpads its button is the right stick click (hold: power attack) and Y / X are quick slots 1 / 2 (held: 3 / 4). default = the mod's older Touch layout (right trigger = sword, right grip = take / use / block, right stick click = zoom); classic = Y leans, X interacts, menu button pauses (held: journal).
notes.QuickSlotHoldTime: How long Y / X are held to use quick slot 3 / 4 instead of 1 / 2, in seconds (0.15 - 2).
notes.GripThresholdLeft: How far the left grip must be squeezed to count (0.05 - 0.95; lower = more sensitive). On controllers whose grip is a button (it clicks) any value works.
notes.GripThresholdRight: The same for the right grip.
notes.FingerTracking: Only for controllers with finger sensors (Valve Index): leave false.
notes.ControllerPitchOffset: If the in-game hands and weapons point higher or lower than your real controllers, tilt them here, in degrees: positive = up, negative = down (-60 - 60).
